Order book stands at INR6,000 crore as of September 2025, with INR4,573 crore from renewable energy, INR1,000 crore from telecom, INR228 crore from railways, and INR190 crore from products.
L1 status on tenders worth INR2,600 crore awaits LOAs in the next couple of months; total order book including L1 could reach INR8,600 crore.
Targets closing order book of INR8,500-9,000 crore by end of March 2026.
Revenue split typically 40% in H1 and 60% in H2; confident of delivering 60% of full-year target in H2 FY26.
Expects to sustain H1 EBITDA margins around 12% with potential 100 bps improvement from economies of scale.
Solar EPC portfolio: 1 GW commissioned, 2.5 GW WIP, 2.5 GW L1 stage; total ~6 GW pipeline plus 2 GW IPP.
BESS order from TNGECL for 200 MW/400 MWh on BOO basis for 12-14 years; will also pursue BESS EPC for PSUs.
Management expects to sustain current margins or improve by ~100 basis points due to economies of scale from larger project sizes.
H2 FY26 financial ratios expected to remain intact with H1 levels as same processes and customers continue.
Adani order book discussed for 3-4 GW over next 3-4 years in Khavda, starting with 650 MW initial order.
EPC PAT margin ~7.5%, O&M and Products ~10%; blended PAT 7.5-7.6% due to RE volume dominance (79-80% of revenue).
Management confident of doubling revenue by FY26 end and tripling by FY27 end (~INR 4,500 cr) driven by confirmed order book.
Madhya Pradesh 2 GW solar + 2 GW BESS IPP project: INR 9,000 cr EPC revenue over 5 years; land pooling 3,000 acres in 4-5 months; first 250 MW IPP next FY.
BESS & Solar IPP (4 GW total) capex over 5 years funded via debt (up to INR 1,500 cr capacity) and equity dilution; first debt tranche Q1 2026.
Defence vertical capex estimated at INR 75-100 cr, IP-centric, manageable from internal accruals, starting in ~2 quarters.
Data centre entry via land pooling/ecosystem first (low capex); ownership after anchor tenant (~2 years); capex quantum unclear yet.
Current BESS order book INR 850 cr; management expects >100% CAGR in order book and execution over next 5 years.
Solar EPC capacity: commissioned 1 GW till 2025; targeting 1 GW in FY26, 2 GW in FY27.
BESS BOO model IRR 16-17% currently, may decline to 13-14%; BESS EPC EBITDA margin ~12-13%.
EPC ROCE expected to improve 3-5% on standalone basis; IPP model ROCE may correct lower due to capital intensity.
PAT margin to remain intact or improve slightly in FY27, benefiting from economies of scale and experience.
Data Centre and Defence revenue recognition expected from Q3 FY27 onwards (approx. 2 quarters).
$1 billion revenue vision by 2031 includes all verticals; ~80% from RE, BESS, Telecom; ~20% from Railways, Data Centre, Defence.
